facts.fact: The first published seasonally adjusted initial claims for the week ending 2026-10-24 were 194,000, released 2026-10-29; that print is not above 194,000.
That same 2026-10-29 release revised the prior week's first print up by 1,000, from 194,000 to 195,000, and put the four-week moving average at 196,750.
For the week ending 2026-10-24, unadjusted state initial claims rose 5,648, while the Labor Department's seasonal factors had expected a rise of 6,040.
The first published figure for the week ending 2026-10-17 was also 194,000, in the 2026-10-22 release.
The first published figure for the week ending 2026-10-10 was 199,000, in the 2026-10-15 release.
FRED ICSA is the seasonally adjusted weekly series, weeks ending Saturday, sourced from the Employment and Training Administration, with the next release dated 2026-11-05.

The weekly claims news release is scheduled for Thursday at 8:30 a.m.
Eastern; the listed 2026 holiday exception is Wednesday, November 25, 2026, so 2026-11-05 is a regular Thursday.

Revised FRED values for the early-November weeks of 2024 and 2025 were 221,000 (week ending 2024-11-02) and 228,000 (week ending 2025-11-01), both above 194,000, while the latest 2026 observation is 194,000.

Reuters reported on 2026-10-29 that economists it polled had expected 199,000 claims for the week ended 2026-10-24, and that claims have stayed mostly below 200,000 since mid-September, near a mid-July reading of 189,000.

Office of Unemployment Insurance
We are soliciting comments on the content and organization of the data on our website and any suggestions you have about improving the accessibility to the data.
We are also interested in your feedback on any data you would like summarized, e.g., benefits across all programs, that would eliminate the need for users to gather data from several reports and calculate the sum.
Your input is important to us in improving the utility of our website as a tool for our customers.
Please email us with your questions and suggestions.
The most recent UI Weekly Claims News Release will always be available at the following URL:https://www.dol.gov/ui/data.pdf.

quotes:
Initial claims for state unemployment benefits fell 1,000 to a seasonally adjusted 194,000 for the week ended October 24, the Labor Department said on Thursday.
Economists polled by Reuters had forecast 199,000 claims for the latest week.
Claims have stayed mostly below 200,000 since mid-September and are within striking distance of the 189,000 level touched in mid-July, which was the lowest reading since 1969.
Economists view the labor market as remaining in a "low-hire, low-fire" state.
